coverage_assessment: Forty-two captured open-web searches (848 ordered headers) cover Finnish, Swedish and English discovery, Helsinki and selected regional outlets, and targeted student, labor, police and event searches. Nine source cards yield two unresolved January leads and four preserved out-of-unit/foreign-target leads; no qualifying event is proposed for inclusion. Four current-unit body opens; zero prior-unit-only source cards; all four reads were partial excerpts with explicit scope. Coverage is limited and does not reproduce LexisNexis or establish absence. One exact SAK query was actually executed twice; both completed native events are separately captured, with the first raw rendered response loss documented in capture_revisions. Baseline, threshold, state-target, source-independence, date/endpoints, response, language-review and continuity gaps remain pending coordinator review.
